brief: Value at array index, or code point at string index
description: Return the value at a zero-based index in an array, or the code point at a zero-based index in a string as a one-code-point string. Negative indexes count from the end (-1 is the last). If the index is out of range, the result is undefined. Bracket indexing a[index] and s[index] use the same out-of-range result (undefined).

parameters.description: Zero-based index, or negative from the end.
parameters.name: index

returns.description: The value at the index, or undefined if out of range.
